description: Group multiple objects into a single group. The first UUID in the array becomes the bottommost item, the last becomes the topmost. If any UUID is not found, nothing is grouped and the missing UUIDs are returned in notFound. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

clipped.description: Create as clipping group. The last UUID becomes the clip path (topmost). Example: [content-uuid, mask-uuid] — mask-uuid clips content-uuid.

uuids.description: UUIDs of objects to group. Order matters: first=bottom, last=top in layer panel.

name: group_objects
title: Group Objects
